author: Cortex

agentixaction.description: Returns the access control list (ACL) of an Amazon S3 bucket in a specified AWS account and region. Shows the grants that define who has access to the bucket and what permissions they have. Use this action to investigate cloud posture issues related to S3 bucket ACLs such as public access grants to AllUsers or AuthenticatedUsers groups, or overly permissive bucket-level permissions. REQUIRES: `account_id`, `region`, and the resource identifier. When these are not present in user input, resolve them first via `CortexListAssets` using the issue's asset_id or asset_name.
agentixaction.name: AWSGetS3BucketACL

agentixaction.description: Creates or modifies the PublicAccessBlock configuration for an Amazon S3 bucket in a specified AWS account and region. Controls whether public access is allowed through ACLs and bucket policies. Use this action to remediate cloud posture issues by enabling all four public access block settings (BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets) to prevent any public access to the bucket and its objects. This is a remediation action that modifies bucket configuration. REQUIRES: `account_id`, `region`, and the resource identifier. When these are not present in user input, resolve them first via `CortexListAssets` using the issue's asset_id or asset_name.
agentixaction.name: AWSUpdateS3PublicAccessBlock

agentixaction.description: Sets the access control list (ACL) permissions for an existing Amazon S3 bucket in a specified AWS account and region. Allows you to define who can access the bucket and what actions they can perform using predefined (canned) ACLs. Use this action to remediate cloud posture issues by setting the bucket ACL to 'private' to remove public access grants. Since 2023, all new S3 buckets block ACLs by default for better security. This is a remediation action that modifies bucket configuration. REQUIRES: `account_id`, `region`, and the resource identifier. When these are not present in user input, resolve them first via `CortexListAssets` using the issue's asset_id or asset_name.
agentixaction.name: AWSPutS3BucketACL

agentixaction.description: Retrieves the public access block configuration for an Amazon S3 bucket in a specified AWS account and region. Shows the current settings that control public access to the bucket and its objects, including BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, and RestrictPublicBuckets. Use this action to investigate cloud posture issues related to S3 public access exposure and verify that public access block is properly enabled. REQUIRES: `account_id`, `region`, and the resource identifier. When these are not present in user input, resolve them first via `CortexListAssets` using the issue's asset_id or asset_name.
agentixaction.name: AWSGetS3PublicAccessBlock

agentixaction.description: Retrieves the bucket policy for an Amazon S3 bucket in a specified AWS account and region. Returns the policy document in JSON format including statements that define who can access the bucket and what actions they can perform. Use this action to investigate cloud posture issues related to S3 bucket policies such as overly permissive access grants, public access via wildcard principals, or missing condition constraints. REQUIRES: `account_id`, `region`, and the resource identifier. When these are not present in user input, resolve them first via `CortexListAssets` using the issue's asset_id or asset_name.
agentixaction.name: AWSGetS3BucketPolicy

commands.description: Returns a list of all buckets owned by the authenticated sender of the request. Required IAM permission: s3:ListAllMyBuckets.
commands.name: aws-s3-buckets-list

commands.description: Returns a list of inventory items. Required IAM permission: ssm:ListInventoryEntries.
commands.name: aws-ssm-inventory-entries-list

commands.description: Runs commands on one or more managed nodes. Required IAM permission: ssm:SendCommand, ssm:ListCommands.
commands.name: aws-ssm-command-run

commands.description: Creates a security group. Required IAM permission: ec2:CreateSecurityGroup.
commands.name: aws-ec2-security-group-create

commands.description: Deletes a security group. Required IAM permission: ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup.
commands.name: aws-ec2-security-group-delete

commands.description: Returns details for a specific security group or all of your security groups, including their rules, tags, and associated VPC information. Required IAM permission: ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups.
commands.name: aws-ec2-security-groups-describe

commands.description: Describes one or more of your Elastic IP addresses. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeAddresses.
commands.name: aws-ec2-addresses-describe

commands.description: Allocates an Elastic IP address to your AWS account. After you allocate the Elastic IP address you can associate it with an instance or network interface. Required IAM Permission: ec2:AllocateAddress.
commands.name: aws-ec2-address-allocate

commands.description: Associates an Elastic IP address, or carrier IP address (for instances that are in subnets in Wavelength Zones) with an instance or a network interface. Required IAM Permission: ec2:AssociateAddress.
commands.name: aws-ec2-address-associate

commands.description: Disassociates an Elastic IP address from the instance or network interface it's associated with. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DisassociateAddress.
commands.name: aws-ec2-address-disassociate

commands.description: Releases the specified Elastic IP address. After releasing an Elastic IP address, it is released to the IP address pool and might be unavailable to you. Required IAM Permission: ec2:ReleaseAddress.
commands.name: aws-ec2-address-release

commands.description: Enables detailed monitoring on one or more running Amazon EC2 instances. Required IAM Permission: ec2:MonitorInstances.
commands.name: aws-ec2-instances-monitor

commands.description: Disables detailed monitoring for one or more running Amazon EC2 instances. Required IAM Permission: ec2:UnmonitorInstances.
commands.name: aws-ec2-instances-unmonitor

commands.description: Requests a reboot of one or more instances. This operation is asynchronous; it only queues a request to reboot the specified instances. Required IAM Permission: ec2:RebootInstances.
commands.name: aws-ec2-instances-reboot

commands.description: Waits until the specified EC2 instances reach the 'running' state. Checks the status every `waiter_delay` seconds until successful or until `waiter_max_attempts` is reached (default maximum attempts: `waiter_max_attempts`). Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeInstances.
commands.name: aws-ec2-instance-running-waiter

commands.description: Waits until EC2 instance status checks pass. Checks every `waiter_delay` seconds until successful or until the maximum number of attempts (`waiter_max_attempts`) is reached. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus.
commands.name: aws-ec2-instance-status-ok-waiter

commands.description: Waits until EC2 instances are in the 'stopped' state. Checks every `waiter_delay` seconds until successful or until the maximum number of attempts (`waiter_max_attempts`) is reached. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeInstances.
commands.name: aws-ec2-instance-stopped-waiter

commands.description: Waits until the specified EC2 instances reach the 'terminated' state. Checks every `waiter_delay` seconds until successful or until the maximum number of attempts (`waiter_max_attempts`) is reached. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeInstances.
commands.name: aws-ec2-instance-terminated-waiter

commands.description: Describes IAM instance profile associations. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeIamInstanceProfileAssociations.
commands.name: aws-ec2-iam-instance-profile-associations-describe

commands.description: Retrieves the encrypted administrator password for a running Windows instance. Required IAM Permission: ec2:GetPasswordData.
commands.name: aws-ec2-password-data-get

commands.description: Describes one or more of the Reserved Instances that you purchased. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeReservedInstances.
commands.name: aws-ec2-reserved-instances-describe

commands.description: Describes the specified EBS volumes or all of your EBS volumes. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeVolumes.
commands.name: aws-ec2-volumes-describe

commands.description: You can modify several parameters of an existing EBS volume, including volume size, volume type, and IOPS capacity. Required IAM Permission: ec2:ModifyVolume.
commands.name: aws-ec2-volume-modify

commands.description: Creates an EBS volume that can be attached to an instance in the same Availability Zone. Required IAM Permission: ec2:CreateVolume.
commands.name: aws-ec2-volume-create

commands.description: Attaches an EBS volume to a running or stopped instance and exposes it to the instance with the specified device name. Required IAM Permission: ec2:AttachVolume.
commands.name: aws-ec2-volume-attach

commands.description: Detaches an EBS volume from an instance. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DetachVolume.
commands.name: aws-ec2-volume-detach

commands.description: Deletes the specified EBS volume. The volume must be in the available state (not attached to an instance). Required IAM Permission: ec2:DeleteVolume.
commands.name: aws-ec2-volume-delete

commands.description: Describes one or more launch templates. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates.
commands.name: aws-ec2-launch-templates-describe

commands.description: Creates a launch template. A launch template contains the parameters to launch an instance. Required IAM Permission: ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate.
commands.name: aws-ec2-launch-template-create

commands.description: Deletes a launch template. Deleting a launch template deletes all of its versions. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate.
commands.name: aws-ec2-launch-template-delete

commands.description: Launches an EC2 Fleet. Required IAM Permission: ec2:CreateFleet.
commands.name: aws-ec2-fleet-create

commands.description: Deletes the specified EC2 Fleet. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DeleteFleets.
commands.name: aws-ec2-fleet-delete

commands.description: Describes one or more of your EC2 Fleets. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeFleets.
commands.name: aws-ec2-fleets-describe

commands.description: Describes the running instances for the specified EC2 Fleet. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeFleetInstances.
commands.name: aws-ec2-fleet-instances-describe

commands.description: Modifies the specified EC2 Fleet. Required IAM Permission: ec2:ModifyFleet.
commands.name: aws-ec2-fleet-modify

commands.description: Describes the specified key pairs or all of your key pairs. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeKeyPairs.
commands.name: aws-ec2-key-pairs-describe

commands.description: Allocates Dedicated Hosts to your account. Requires the instance type or family, the Availability Zone, and the quantity of hosts to allocate. Required IAM Permission: ec2:AllocateHosts.
commands.name: aws-ec2-hosts-allocate

commands.description: Releases the specified Dedicated Hosts. Required IAM Permission: ec2:ReleaseHosts.
commands.name: aws-ec2-hosts-release

commands.description: Creates a Traffic Mirror session. A Traffic Mirror session actively copies packets from a Traffic Mirror source to a Traffic Mirror target. Required IAM Permission: ec2:CreateTrafficMirrorSession.
commands.name: aws-ec2-traffic-mirror-session-create

commands.description: Deletes a specified VPC. You must detach or delete all gateways and resources that are associated with the VPC before you can delete it. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DeleteVpc.
commands.name: aws-ec2-vpc-delete

commands.description: Creates a VPC endpoint for a specified service. An endpoint enables you to create a private connection between your VPC and the service. Required IAM Permission: ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint.
commands.name: aws-ec2-vpc-endpoint-create

commands.description: A description of one or more of your internet gateways. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DescribeInternetGateways.
commands.name: aws-ec2-internet-gateway-describe

commands.description: Detaches an internet gateway from a VPC, disabling connectivity between the internet and the VPC. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DetachInternetGateway.
commands.name: aws-ec2-internet-gateway-detach

commands.description: Deletes the specified internet gateway. You must detach the internet gateway from the VPC before you can delete it. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DeleteInternetGateway.
commands.name: aws-ec2-internet-gateway-delete

commands.description: Deletes the specified subnet. You must terminate all running instances in the subnet before you can delete the subnet. Required IAM Permission: ec2:DeleteSubnet.
commands.name: aws-ec2-subnet-delete

commands.description: Creates an entry (a rule) in a network ACL with the specified rule number. Required IAM Permission: ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry.
commands.name: aws-ec2-network-acl-entry-create

integration.description: Cloud integrations are installed from the **Data Sources** page. To configure a cloud integration, go to Settings > Data Sources and click "Add Data Source", select AWS, then in Advanced Settings > Security Capabilities, enable "Automation".
integration.name: Amazon Web Services
